architecture.mechanism: Automated safety mechanisms that provide timely intervention to prevent accidents, combined with resolution of conflicts among safety interventions to enhance system resilience and reliability.
architecture.intervention: Add an independent automated rollaway-intervention layer to the Camry automated stop system: when the powertrain controller detects park-selected state plus any measured vehicle motion (wheel speed or yaw) after driver door-open/exit, it autonomously commands the electric parking brake and cuts powertrain torque, overriding any conflicting throttle or gear-state command until the vehicle is confirmed stationary and secured.
architecture.expected_effect: The vehicle cannot roll or accelerate while parked on a flat surface even if a perception, gear-selection, or throttle command fault occurs, because the brake-based intervention acts independently of the suspect control path and resolves command conflicts in favor of the safe (stationary) state.
architecture.falsification_test: Place a 2020 Camry in PARK on a flat surface, simulate the reported fault (driver exits, vehicle begins rolling/accelerating), and verify the automated intervention commands the parking brake and cuts torque within a set time/distance threshold, holding the vehicle at zero speed; repeat with an injected conflicting throttle command and confirm the safe-state override still prevails.
